credit.notes: Facilities (company releases): $1 billion syndicated senior secured credit facility closed 2026-05-07, upsized from $275 million (Aug 2025), J.P. Morgan lead arranger (ev_110009); $926 million senior secured term loan B priced 2026-08-12, SOFR + 3.00%, matures 2030-12-31, Morgan Stanley lead left, funds GPUs dedicated to one unnamed investment-grade offtaker (ev_110002, ev_110003, ev_110004); $1.008 billion fixed rate delayed draw term loan closed 2026-10-01, 6.78%, matures 2033-05-30, J.P. relationships.title: Nvidia revenue sharing and credit support for the Firmus Batam campus
relationships.insight_template: Nvidia gives credit support to {counterparty}'s Batam campus in return for a revenue share, so its exposure grows if customers do not take the capacity.
relationships.definition: Firmus announced a strategic compute partnership with NVIDIA running through 2034, anchored by a 360 MW NVIDIA DSX campus in Batam, Indonesia, covering up to 170,000 NVIDIA accelerators. Firmus procures NVIDIA infrastructure through a revenue-sharing and credit-support model: NVIDIA earns product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on the supported capacity. Nvidia's own blog names Firmus as one of the first partners in this model. Neither side discloses the size or trigger of the credit support.

contingent_max.trigger: Firmus cannot sell the supported Batam capacity to customers (form and cap of the credit support not disclosed)

reconciliation.nvidia_side: Nvidia's blog of 2026-07-01 describes a revenue-sharing and credit-support model for AI clouds and names Firmus and its Batam campus (360 MW, up to 170,000 GPUs). Nvidia's 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-07-26 reports AI cloud agreements in aggregate ($36 billion) without naming partners.
reconciliation.counterparty_side: Firmus release of 2026-06-28: partnership through 2034, revenue-sharing and credit-support model, up to 170,000 accelerators, expected US$25 to 30 billion from committed offtake over six years.

differences.nvidia_value: Not stated in the Nvidia blog
Included, if at all, only in the unattributed AI cloud agreements aggregate

credit.wwr_reason: Credit support on Batam capacity is called on when Firmus cannot sell that capacity, which is when Firmus is weakest.
credit.collateral: Not disclosed. Nvidia would receive capacity or a revenue share, not security over the campus, as far as the releases say.
credit.tenor: Partnership runs through 2034; GPU deliveries across 2027 and 2028.
